exam.gateIntro: A mock exam in the same format as the real one. Take it in a single sitting, without looking anything up: the point is to measure where you are, and an inflated score can't tell you whether you're ready.
exam.gateFactFlagging: You can leave questions blank, flag them, and come back
exam.gateFactAutoSubmit: It submits itself when the clock runs out
exam.gateNotSaved: This attempt won't be saved. If you close the tab, it's gone.
exam.gateNotSavedSignIn: Sign in before you start if you want to keep the result.
exam.startFailed: We couldn't open the attempt. Try again in a moment.
exam.saveFailedNotice: We're not able to save your answers right now. You can keep going, but don't close the tab.
exam.questionsOnlyInSpanish: The questions in this exam are still only available in Spanish. The interface is in your language.
exam.confirmBody: Once you submit you can't answer any more, and you'll see your score plus a review of all {total} questions.
exam.confirmUnanswered: You have {count} unanswered. There's no penalty for a wrong answer, so it's worth marking something on every question before you submit.
exam.confirmFlagged: You still have {count} flagged for review.
exam.autoSubmittedNotice: This was submitted automatically because the time ran out.
exam.passMarkNote: You need {score} out of {max} to pass.
exam.unansweredNote: You left {count} blank, and they count as wrong. The real exam has no penalty for a wrong answer: never leave one empty.
exam.approximationNote: This score is an approximation. The real exam includes 15 questions that don't count and uses an equating model AWS doesn't publish, so treat the number as a signal that you're close, not as an exact prediction.
exam.domainNote: Use this to spot which domain to go back to. With few questions per domain, one right or wrong answer moves the percentage a lot, so read it as a signal rather than a grade.
exam.reviewIntro: Here's every question with the correct answer and why each option is or isn't right.
exam.retakeHint: Study your weakest domain first: taking it again without studying measures exactly what you just measured.
